title: IELTS Listening Part 2: Graphic Design Company Office Move

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Part two. You will hear the manager of a graphic design company talking to staff about an upcoming office move. First, you have some time to read questions eleven to fifteen. Now listen carefully and answer questions eleven to fifteen.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: Okay, let's get started. Now, as you all know, we'll be moving into our new office building next month, and I need to give you some information about the move.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: When our graphic design company was established with just the two of us ten years ago, this space was ideal and the rent is very reasonable.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: But we've just outgrown the space since we took on six new staff last year. So we've decided to cut short our lease.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: I'm sure you're going to like the new office. We thought long and hard about the location and will be relocating to the industrial estate, which is also where all our materials are printed.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: That will mean we can save on transport costs, and we should be able to pass these savings on to our customers. That way, we can keep our prices competitive as well.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: Now, it's important that you're all aware of your responsibilities so that the move goes smoothly. We don't require you to pack your things yourselves. The movers will take care of all of that.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: I know some of you are wondering what we're going to do about all the office furniture. The new office will be completely fitted out, so we don't need any of this.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: What we've decided to do is offer it all for sale at very reasonable prices. So if you or anyone on the staff knows someone who wants a chair or filing cabinet, please let them know.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: Those of you who previously stored files in your own offices are going to be sharing an open plan office. So this is going to require some adjustments in how we work.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: Over the next few weeks, I'd like you to go through your files and get rid of outdated and unnecessary paperwork. There's no need to keep copies of anything.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: Remember, things you're currently working on should stay in the office due to our privacy laws.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: Now, the day of the move itself will be a Saturday when we are closed for business. Thank you to those who have offered to come in on that day to assist, but we'd rather you didn't. We'll leave it all to the professionals.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: So just go directly to the new building on the Monday, and by then, hopefully, all the hard work will have been done.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Before you hear the rest of the talk, you have some time to look at questions sixteen to twenty. Now listen and answer questions sixteen to twenty.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: Now, if you take a look at the plan, I'll show you the layout of our new office. Can you all see the lifts at the bottom of the plan?

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: Now, as you come out of the lifts, you'll see the reception is on the other side of the corridor. As you can see, it's quite a large space, so there will be ample room for the receptionist desk straight in front of you, a waiting area for our clients on the left, and a display area over to the right.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: Now, to reach your desk, you'll need to walk through the reception to the open plan area at the back of the office suite.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: You'll see some desks there drawn on the plan. For the sales staff, we've asked the builders to put in a partition between your area and the rest of the staff. We're aware that you're on the phone a lot talking to clients, and you'll need some privacy. So that's your area in the top left corner.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: Now, if you look at the very top of the plan, opposite the doorway, you'll see the designer's desks. We didn't want to put you too close to the entrance. Those desks to the right of the entrance to the open plan area will be for temporary staff.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: Okay, let's see now. What else do I need to point out? Oh, yes. Now, I know some of you are concerned about noise problems in the open plan area, so I want to reassure you that we have made allowances for that, and there will be a conference room that you can reserve for meetings. That's it just behind reception on the right.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: And we're also going to have our own lunch room, which is a big improvement on our current facilities. It's outside the office and you can see it at the bottom of your plan on the right. So no more eating at your desks, which is great news. Now, are there any questions or comments? That is the end of part two. You now have thirty seconds to check your answers to part two.

questions.prompt: Why has the graphic design company decided to move to a new office building?

options.label: A
options.text: The rent on the current building has become too expensive.

options.label: B
options.text: The current office is too small after recruiting additional employees.

options.label: C
options.text: The lease on their existing premises has recently expired.

questions.explanation: 经理首先提到目前的租金非常合理（the rent is very reasonable），排除 A 项；随后通过转折词 But 指出核心原因：去年新招了 6 名员工后，现有空间已经不够用了（we've just outgrown the space since we took on six new staff last year），这与 B 选项 completely 对应。最后提到公司决定提前终止租约（cut short our lease），说明租约并未自然到期，排除 C 项。

audioRef.sentence: But we've just outgrown the space since we took on six new staff last year. So we've decided to cut short our lease.

questions.prompt:
Complete the note below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS for the answer.

Benefit of the new location: Being situated in the ________ where materials are printed will reduce transport costs and keep prices competitive.
questions.explanation: 定位词为 location（位置）和 where materials are printed（材料印刷地）。经理在 33-42 秒明确说明，公司经过深思熟虑后决定搬迁至工业园区（relocating to the industrial estate），那里也是所有材料印刷的地方。

audioRef.sentence: I'm sure you're going to like the new office. We thought long and hard about the location and will be relocating to the industrial estate, which is also where all our materials are printed.

questions.prompt: What is the company planning to do with the existing office furniture?

options.label: A
options.text: Have the professional movers transport it to the new building.

options.label: B
options.text: Discard all the old chairs and filing cabinets.

options.label: C
options.text: Sell the items at affordable prices to interested buyers.

questions.explanation: 经理指出新办公室已经完全装配好了家具（completely fitted out, so we don't need any of this），排除 A 项；接着说明公司的决定是将所有旧家具以非常合理的价格出售（offer it all for sale at very reasonable prices），对应 C 选项中的 Sell the items at affordable prices。

audioRef.sentence: What we've decided to do is offer it all for sale at very reasonable prices. So if you or anyone on the staff knows someone who wants a chair or filing cabinet, please let them know.

questions.prompt: Which TWO instructions does the manager give to staff regarding the office move?

options.label: A
options.text: Pack their personal office belongings into boxes themselves.

options.label: B
options.text: Dispose of out-of-date and unneeded documents.

options.label: C
options.text: Take current work files home over the moving weekend.

options.label: D
options.text: Come in on Saturday to supervise the removal company.

options.label: E
options.text: Report straight to the new premises on Monday morning.

questions.explanation: 本题考察多选题的同义替换与否定排除。经理明确表示不需要自己打包（don't require you to pack your things yourselves），排除 A；由于隐私法规定，正在处理的文件必须留在办公室（stay in the office due to our privacy laws），排除 C；对于主动提出周六来帮忙的员工，经理表示希望他们不要来（we'd rather you didn't），排除 D。正确指令为：清理过时和不必要的纸质文件（get rid of outdated and unnecessary paperwork，对应 B 项）以及周一直接去新办公楼上班（go directly to the new building on the Monday，对应 E 项）。

audioRef.sentence: Over the next few weeks, I'd like you to go through your files and get rid of outdated and unnecessary paperwork. There's no need to keep copies of anything. Remember, things you're currently working on should stay in the office due to our privacy laws. Now, the day of the move itself will be a Saturday when we are closed for business. Thank you to those who have offered to come in on that day to assist, but we'd rather you didn't. We'll leave it all to the professionals. So just go directly to the new building on the Monday, and by then, hopefully, all the hard work will have been done.

questions.prompt: Match each area or group of desks in the new office with its correct location on the floor plan.

options.label: A
options.text: In the top left corner of the open-plan area, separated by a partition

options.label: B
options.text: At the very top of the plan, directly opposite the doorway

options.label: C
options.text: To the right of the entrance leading into the open-plan area

options.label: D
options.text: Just behind the reception area on the right-hand side

options.label: E
options.text: Outside the office at the bottom of the plan on the right

items.sentence: For the sales staff, we've asked the builders to put in a partition between your area and the rest of the staff. We're aware that you're on the phone a lot talking to clients, and you'll need some privacy. So that's your area in the top left corner.
items.explanation: 经理提到为销售人员（sales staff）安装了隔断（put in a partition）以保证打电话时的隐私，位置在左上角（in the top left corner），因此匹配 A。

items.sentence: Now, if you look at the very top of the plan, opposite the doorway, you'll see the designer's desks. We didn't want to put you too close to the entrance.
items.explanation: 经理指出平面图最上方、门口正对面（at the very top of the plan, opposite the doorway）是设计师的办公桌（designer's desks），因此匹配 B。

items.sentence: Those desks to the right of the entrance to the open plan area will be for temporary staff.
items.explanation: 经理明确说明开放式办公区入口右侧的桌子（to the right of the entrance to the open plan area）是给临时员工（temporary staff）使用的，因此匹配 C。

items.sentence: Oh, yes. Now, I know some of you are concerned about noise problems in the open plan area, so I want to reassure you that we have made allowances for that, and there will be a conference room that you can reserve for meetings. That's it just behind reception on the right.
items.explanation: 为了应对开放式办公区的噪音问题，公司设置了可预订的会议室（conference room），位置就在前台后方的右侧（just behind reception on the right），因此匹配 D。

items.sentence: And we're also going to have our own lunch room, which is a big improvement on our current facilities. It's outside the office and you can see it at the bottom of your plan on the right.
items.explanation: 经理最后介绍了新增的午餐室（lunch room），位于办公室外部、平面图底部右侧（outside the office and you can see it at the bottom of your plan on the right），因此匹配 E。

questions.explanation: 雅思听力 Part 2 经典的平面图方位匹配题（Map Labeling）。解题关键在于紧跟起点（lifts at the bottom of the plan -> reception -> open plan area at the back），并准确捕捉方位介词短语：in the top left corner（左上角）、at the very top / opposite the doorway（最顶部/正对门口）、to the right of the entrance（入口右侧）、just behind reception on the right（前台正后方偏右）以及 at the bottom of your plan on the right（平面图底部右侧）。

audioRef.sentence: For the sales staff, we've asked the builders to put in a partition between your area and the rest of the staff. We're aware that you're on the phone a lot talking to clients, and you'll need some privacy. So that's your area in the top left corner. Now, if you look at the very top of the plan, opposite the doorway, you'll see the designer's desks. We didn't want to put you too close to the entrance. Those desks to the right of the entrance to the open plan area will be for temporary staff. Okay, let's see now. What else do I need to point out? Oh, yes. Now, I know some of you are concerned about noise problems in the open plan area, so I want to reassure you that we have made allowances for that, and there will be a conference room that you can reserve for meetings. That's it just behind reception on the right. And we're also going to have our own lunch room, which is a big improvement on our current facilities. It's outside the office and you can see it at the bottom of your plan on the right.

keySentences.english: But we've just outgrown the space since we took on six new staff last year. So we've decided to cut short our lease.
keySentences.chinese: 但自从去年我们新招了六名员工后，这里的空间已经不够用了。因此我们决定提前终止租约。
keySentences.examPoint: 转折因果与高频短语考点：But 引出核心搬迁原因，outgrow the space（因发展壮大而使空间显得狭小）、take on（雇佣/聘用）以及 cut short our lease（提前终止租约）是雅思 Part 2 职场与场地变更场景的黄金表达。

keySentences.english: I know some of you are wondering what we're going to do about all the office furniture. The new office will be completely fitted out, so we don't need any of this.
keySentences.chinese: 我知道你们中有些人想知道我们打算怎么处理所有的办公家具。新办公室将会配备齐全的设施，所以我们不需要这里的任何家具了。
keySentences.examPoint: 被动语态与短语替换考点：be completely fitted out 意为“完全装配好/配备齐全”，直接解释了为何旧家具不再需要搬走，常在单选题中替换 furnished 或 equipped。

keySentences.english: Over the next few weeks, I'd like you to go through your files and get rid of outdated and unnecessary paperwork. There's no need to keep copies of anything.
keySentences.chinese: 在接下来的几周里，我希望你们彻底检查一下自己的文件，清理掉过时和不必要的纸质材料。没有任何必要保留任何副本。
keySentences.examPoint: 指令性同义替换考点：go through（仔细检查/审阅）与 get rid of（处理掉/丢弃）构成连贯动作，outdated and unnecessary paperwork 常在题干中被替换为 old or unneeded documents。

keySentences.english: Thank you to those who have offered to come in on that day to assist, but we'd rather you didn't. We'll leave it all to the professionals.
keySentences.chinese: 感谢那些主动提出当天来帮忙的同事，但我们希望你们不要来。我们会把这一切都交给专业人士处理。
keySentences.examPoint: 委婉拒绝（否定陷阱）考点：先用 Thank you 肯定员工的好意（设置干扰项），紧接着用 but we'd rather you didn't（委婉拒绝，意为“请不要来”）反转句意，是雅思听力经典的欲抑先扬设题套路。

keySentences.english: For the sales staff, we've asked the builders to put in a partition between your area and the rest of the staff. We're aware that you're on the phone a lot talking to clients, and you'll need some privacy.
keySentences.chinese: 对于销售人员，我们已经让建筑工人在你们的区域和其他员工区域之间安装一道隔断。我们知道你们经常打电话与客户交谈，因此需要一些隐私空间。
keySentences.examPoint: 平面图建筑词汇与前置定语考点：For the sales staff 将信号词前置（提醒考生立刻关注该题号），put in a partition（安装隔墙/隔板）是办公平面图题目的高频建筑特征词。

keySentences.english: Now, I know some of you are concerned about noise problems in the open plan area, so I want to reassure you that we have made allowances for that, and there will be a conference room that you can reserve for meetings.
keySentences.chinese: 我知道你们有些人担心开放式办公区的噪音问题，所以我想向大家保证，我们已经充分考虑到了这一点，并且会设有一间可供大家预订开会的会议室。
keySentences.examPoint: 高阶习语与解决方案考点：make allowances for 意为“考虑到……并做好准备/留出余地”，reassure（使安心/消除疑虑）引出针对 noise problems 的具体空间配置方案。

vocabulary.chinese: 因成长/发展壮大而使（原有空间、衣物等）不再适用
vocabulary.exampleSentence: But we've just outgrown the space since we took on six new staff last year.

vocabulary.chinese: 聘用，雇佣；承担（工作或责任）
vocabulary.exampleSentence: But we've just outgrown the space since we took on six new staff last year.
So we've decided to cut short our lease.
We thought long and hard about the location and will be relocating to the industrial estate, which is also where all our materials are printed.

vocabulary.chinese: 把（节省的费用、成本等）转给/让利给……
vocabulary.exampleSentence: That will mean we can save on transport costs, and we should be able to pass these savings on to our customers.

vocabulary.chinese: 配备好家具及设备，装修装配齐全
vocabulary.exampleSentence: The new office will be completely fitted out, so we don't need any of this.

vocabulary.chinese: 开放式办公室（无独立小隔间的办公区）
vocabulary.exampleSentence: Those of you who previously stored files in your own offices are going to be sharing an open plan office.
Over the next few weeks, I'd like you to go through your files and get rid of outdated and unnecessary paperwork.

vocabulary.chinese: 充足的，宽敞的，绰绰有余的
vocabulary.exampleSentence: As you can see, it's quite a large space, so there will be ample room for the receptionist desk straight in front of you.
For the sales staff, we've asked the builders to put in a partition between your area and the rest of the staff.

vocabulary.chinese: 考虑到，体谅，为……留出余地/做好准备
vocabulary.exampleSentence: Now, I know some of you are concerned about noise problems in the open plan area, so I want to reassure you that we have made allowances for that.
